rows.jp: 俺は二人に密着して座った。
rows.en: I sat down pressed against both of them.

ghs.en: I sat glued close to the two.
Kiri: "Wh-, what do you think you are doing?!"
Miki: "Kyah, really!"

rows.jp: 「あーうまいうまい。肉って腐る寸前がうまいけど、腐る寸前のパンってのもオツだよなー！」
rows.en: “Mmm, good, good. Meat tastes best right before it rots, but bread on the verge of rotting has a certain something too!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Ahhh delicious, delicious. They say meat on the verge of spoiling is tasty, but bread on the verge of spoiling also has a quaint and unorthodox taste, don't it!"
Kiri: "Please don't be here!"

rows.jp: 「きゃ、ちょっと、あはは……たいへんだぁ」

ghs.en: Miki: "Kyah, really, ahahah... what a problem."
Strained laughter,

rows.jp: でも、そんな嫌そうではない。
rows.en: But she did not look all that unhappy about it.

ghs.en: but it doesn't look like she dislikes it that much.

rows.jp: 「うまいうまいっ、あ、そのおかずおいしそう！」
rows.en: “Delicious, delicious! Oh, that side dish looks good!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Tasty tastyyy, ah, that side dish looks delicious!"

rows.jp: 「こらー！　わたしのお弁当！」

ghs.en: Kiri: "Hands oooff! That is my boxed lunch!"
Taichi: "What's thaaat!"
Begin quarreling.

rows.en: “Ahahahaha... I don't know what to make of this.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Ahahahahah... what indeeed!"

rows.jp: 俺たちが言い争うのを、美希は複雑な表情で見ていた。
rows.en: Miki watched us bicker, a complicated look on her face.

ghs.en: While we fought with words, Miki looked on with a complicated expression on her face.
